overview.new_call_cap: Up to 3 calls per day (15 total slots per week)
overview.what_counts_as_a_call: 1:1 client sessions (long-term, program, prospects) + TikTok lives (each live = 1 full slot)
overview.tiktok_lives_target: 2–3 per week (we plan for 3 to keep pipeline strong)
overview.pipeline_goal: Close 1 new program client per week → requires minimum 3 prospect calls per week
overview.all_categories: Now fully integrated under the 15-slot weekly cap so nothing conflicts

category_1_long_term.description: Month-to-month retainer clients (one 60-min call per week, auto-renew)

category_2_six_to_eight_week_program.description: High-ticket program clients (one 60-min call per week for 6–8 weeks)
category_2_six_to_eight_week_program.recommended_stagger: Start 1 new client every 1–1.2 weeks (or exactly 5 new every 6 weeks for a 6-week program). Replace graduates immediately to stay at 5 concurrent.
category_2_six_to_eight_week_program.notes: This uses the exact remaining slots after long-term + prospects + TikTok lives

category_3_one_off_prospects.description: New prospect calls (one 60-min session only; may upgrade)
category_3_one_off_prospects.notes: Minimum to hit 30% close rate and get 1 new program signup per week

category_4_tiktok_lives.description: Live sessions to fill pipeline (60–90 min each)
category_4_tiktok_lives.recommended_schedule: Block 3 days that still leave room for your other 2 calls that day (e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri). Each live takes 1 full slot out of the 3-call daily max.
category_4_tiktok_lives.notes: Now officially counts as a 'call' — never schedule if you already have 3 other calls booked that day

weekly_capacity_summary.example_balanced_week: 4 long-term + 3 prospects + 3 TikTok lives + 5 program = exactly 15 calls
weekly_capacity_summary.never_exceed: 15 calls (or 3 per day) in any single week

holistic_tracking_recommendation.how_to_use: Every Sunday: count active clients in each category + planned TikTok lives. Total must = ≤15. If over, delay new prospects or program onboardings.
holistic_tracking_recommendation.staggering_rule: Program clients start staggered (1 every 1–1.2 weeks). Prospects fixed at 3/week. TikTok lives blocked first on lighter days.
holistic_tracking_recommendation.safe_total_steady_state: 4 long-term + 5 program + 3 prospects + 3 TikTok lives = exactly 15 calls/week
holistic_tracking_recommendation.growth_rate: You will close ~1 new program client every week (30% of 3 prospects) while staying fully booked but not overloaded.
